transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... my family thought I should come talk to someone. We've been having some disagreements lately. 

It's... it's about my father's death. Everyone keeps telling me that the hospital records and the donation emails all line up, but... I don't know. I've been comparing the timestamps, and there are missing attachments. Plus, the way certain people in the community just avoid my questions now... it's just obvious to me that someone is hiding what really happened. But my family thinks I need to drop it, so... here I am, I guess.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't seem to hear?
No. I don't... hear things, if that's what you mean. Just normal sounds.
How long have you felt that people are hiding the truth about your father's death?
About nine months, I guess. It was... right around the time I had to start sorting through his records and old messages after he passed away.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts were being broadcast, read, or controlled by an outside force?
No. I mean... no, of course not. My thoughts are my own. I don't really know why you'd ask that.
Before your father passed away, did you often find yourself questioning whether people close to you, like friends or coworkers, could really be trusted?
No. Not really. I mostly just kept to myself and did my work. Everything was... pretty normal before he died. I didn't have any reason to question anyone back then.
